Name: (cp) haley's bracelet event matters
Author: eltolinde
Description:
[size=1]you need[/size]
the newest [url=https://smapi.io]smapi[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url] 2.9.0 or later

[size=1]compatibility with other mods[/size]
the bracelet asset is an overlay, meaning it can (technically) work with whichever other character sprite replacer(s) you have installed alongside. note that that doesn't mean it is guaranteed to look correct, depending on body proportions.
